agile_enumerated_library.definition: distinct components across AGILE's 12,276-member virtual candidate library, which is the complete cross-product of its block set

measured_1100_product_set.definition: distinct components across the 1,100 curated single-compound AGILE products

component_registries.note: The measured set and the AGILE enumerated library are different reference sets and must not be conflated. The manuscript's component-count sentence describes the measured set, not the library.

oracle_qualified_registry.definition: distinct components across generated designs the activity model scores

training_corpus_block_registry.definition: distinct components across the 112,386-product training corpus

carries_component_absent_from_measured_s.definition: at least one component outside the measured 20 amines, 11 aldehydes, 5 isocyanides

carries_component_absent_from_training_c.definition: at least one component outside the training corpus block registry

product_absent_from_agile_library.definition: absent from AGILE's 12,276-member enumerated library, compared stereo-free on both sides

product_absent_from_train_fold.definition: canonical product SMILES absent from the 66,464-product train fold; the standard generative-chemistry novelty metric

purpose: Single traceable source for every generation, novelty, component-count and panel number stated in the manuscript.

smarts.unsaturation: any carbon-carbon double bond in the component
